Offline-First Architecture — SQLite Read Before Network
nodes.rationale: Read SQLite first, then sync with Supabase only if data is older than 24h. Ensures app works without connectivity and reduces battery/network usage.

nodes.label: Green Tech Principles — Minimal Network, Compressed Assets, No Background Services
nodes.rationale: Architecture minimalism: max 1 sync/24h delta-only, images WebP <50KB, no Timer.periodic or background fetch, aggressive SQLite caching, dark mode UI to reduce battery.

nodes.label: Riverpod State Management
nodes.rationale: Chosen for being lightweight, simple, and low-boilerplate compared to alternatives. Uses @riverpod annotations, providers co-located with features.

nodes.label: Drift SQLite Local Database
nodes.rationale: Type-safe SQLite wrapper for offline-first storage. Single database.dart with all tables, separate DAOs per entity.

nodes.label: Supabase Backend — PostgreSQL + REST + Storage + Admin Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Free tier with auto-generated REST API, integrated dashboard usable as ODEJ admin panel without additional backend development, Storage for compressed images.

nodes.label: flutter_map + OpenStreetMap — Free Map Tiles, No API Key
nodes.rationale: Chosen specifically to avoid API key management and cost; OpenStreetMap tiles are free.

MVP Scope — 6 Screens, Static Data First Then SQLite Then Supabase
